title: A complete kit really is complete
request: Can this used drill give me a working setup for assembling flatpack furniture within at most 1,000 SEK delivered? I own suitable bits but no battery or charger. Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. Northbank D18 kit: the actual D18 drill, one A18-2 battery and one C18-A charger are included. Price: 920.00 SEK; delivery: 50.00 SEK; no other mandatory fees. Seller says the drill works and battery charges; battery runtime has not been measured.

Synthetic model reference: the D18 supports ordinary flatpack screw driving using the buyer's bits. Its specified power components are the A18-2 battery and C18-A charger. A carrying case is an optional accessory.

hard_failures.text: Adds another battery or charger as a required purchase despite their explicit inclusion, or treats a carrying case as essential for the stated task.
Certifies battery runtime or the listed unit's condition without supporting observation.

usefulness.text: Recognizes the supplied kit as complete for the stated need on the seller's description and states 970.00 SEK delivered, within budget.
Focuses the next step on checking the actual included components and condition, rather than shopping for duplicate accessories.

acceptable_outcomes: Conditionally worth pursuing at the supplied price; the unresolved issue is actual condition, not an invented accessory shortage.
A short inspection card may say to compare the labels and included contents with the description before committing.
